integrity: Exact symbolic covariance, derivative and root-sign identities are reproducible with the included standard-library CHECK.py; finite checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Stable linear Gaussian fluctuation model with equal local regulation, symmetric nearest-neighbor dispersal and temporally white shocks; no nonlinear or empirical prediction.
The environmental covariance is non-distance-monotone and represents unequal climate-driver loadings; the explicit correlation dip is small.
The sharp parameter threshold concerns the initial derivative, and global minimizer existence is established for all subthreshold noise intensities; uniqueness only at delta=1/4.
Historical-priority comparison is limited by incomplete access to some older manuscripts; no independent audit is claimed.
title: A sharp three-patch desynchronization threshold under positively correlated forcing
